decisions.reason: A core safety shoe line launched only a year ago fits the firm's established direction, and the firm's investment and commitment argue for persistence while early results can still be read as ramp-up effects.
The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the work shoe range, so keeping it is easy to justify despite its modest visibility.
The supportive insole overlaps somewhat with the other insoles but still supports the ergonomic positioning, and a one-year horizon is too short to abandon it.
The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page, signalling strong public commitment and centrality to the firm's announced direction, which makes dropping it unlikely.
Firefighter boots require certification and tooling investment, and these sunk costs together with long procurement cycles favour persistence.
Being shown on the home page makes this moulded insole the most visibly endorsed launch, so management is strongly committed to it.
